'''Jo-Dapshi Gorobunn''' was an [[Aki-Aki]] [[farmer]] who lost one of his trunks in a farm injury. Gorobunn was one of many Aki-Aki who attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]]. Gorobunn's family's heraldic pennant was on a flag on a [[Arunskin 75D skimmer|75D skimmer]] that [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] stole.<ref name="TROS VD" />
